entities.summary: The Basilica of Jesus the Adolescent, also known as the Salesian church is a Catholic church in Nazareth in Israel, belonging to the Salesians of Don Bosco. The church is located next to the school of the Salesians. Built in Gothic style between 1906 and 1923 on a hill called "Mount of the Start," which overlooks the city, this church is where, according to tradition, Jesus spent his youth.
